name: Avenzia PostgreSQL 16 privé
author: parker@parkervcp.com
description: PostgreSQL 16 avec rôle applicatif non superutilisateur, SCRAM et accès réseau local au nœud.

config.startup: {"done":["database system is ready to accept connections"]}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
adduser -D -h /home/container container
chown container: /mnt/server
if [ -f /mnt/server/postgres_db/PG_VERSION ]; then echo 'Base existante conservée'; exit 0; fi
su container -c 'initdb -D /mnt/server/postgres_db -A scram-sha-256 -U "$PGUSER" --pwfile=<(printf "%s\n" "$PGPASSWORD")'
mkdir -p /mnt/server/postgres_db/run
chown container: /mnt/server/postgres_db/run
printf '\nhost all all samenet scram-sha-256\n' >> /mnt/server/postgres_db/pg_hba.conf
su container -c 'pg_ctl -D /mnt/server/postgres_db -o "-c listen_addresses= -c unix_socket_directories=/mnt/server/postgres_db/run" -w start'
PGHOST=/mnt/server/postgres_db/run psql -U "$PGUSER" -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -v app_password="$APP_DB_PASSWORD" <<'SQL'
CREATE ROLE avenzia LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOCREATEDB NOCREATEROLE PASSWORD :'app_password';
CREATE DATABASE avenzia OWNER avenzia;
SQL
su container -c 'pg_ctl -D /mnt/server/postgres_db -m fast -w stop'
echo 'PostgreSQL Avenzia initialisé'
